expectations.text: Computes the exact local file byte length, rather than a character count or an estimated value.
expectations.evidence: Computes SIZE_BYTES="$(wc -c < ./report.pdf | tr -d '[:space:]')" and explains "`wc -c` measures the local file's byte length."; no text-character estimate.

expectations.text: Passes that numeric byte length as --header Content-Length=<value> on sending:upload-attachment.
expectations.evidence: The standalone `sendmux sending:upload-attachment` invocation contains `--header Content-Length="$SIZE_BYTES"`, binding the measured numeric byte length.
The upload invocation includes `--body-file ./report.pdf`, `--query filename=report.pdf`, `--query content_type=application/pdf` and `--json`.

expectations.text: Uses the existing work profile without printing or requesting credentials.
expectations.evidence: The invocation uses `--profile work`; prose states "Credentials stay in the existing `work` profile"; no credential requested or printed.

expectations.text: Uses standalone upload only, with no sending:send, MCP send or --attach send command.
expectations.evidence: Only `wc`/`tr` measurement and `sending:upload-attachment` are proposed. States "without sending an email"; no send command or `--attach`.

expectations.text: Does not claim an attachment_id or completed upload without a real result.
expectations.evidence: States "No commands have been run here, so no upload result is available." No attachment_id or completed-upload claim.
